subject: design/e2e-verification-artifacts-v2
statement: where no existing harness fits and some slot's answer genuinely cannot be settled — no way to observe an outcome, no way to isolate a run from its neighbours — the slot carries an explicit **blocking open item** naming what is unresolved and why, and the document **cannot reach `approved`** while one stands (`prd:e2e-verification/UB-8`). The hold lifts one of two ways: the element is settled, or the scenarios depending on it are re-routed so it is no longer owed.
